# Rob Reece

> Rob Reece helps broke beginners get their first online sale with simple offers, honest copy and organic traffic. Solo marketer, no sales calls, no ad budget. Brand: 5 Solas Marketing. Related brand: CultLike Marketing.

## Free tools
- [The Robot Tells](https://robcreece.com/robot-tells/): 12 tells that scream 'AI wrote this', each with a 30-second fix.
- [The AI Word List](https://robcreece.com/ai-word-list/): The words that move people to reply, call, or buy, with examples.
- [The One-Prompt Website](https://robcreece.com/one-prompt-website/): One prompt that builds a free website and signup page with Claude.

## Products
- [The One-Chat Launchpad](https://robcreece.com/launchpad/) ($19): Paste one master prompt into Claude and answer its questions. You finish with a site you control and a page that collects emails. A starter template and two cheat sheets keep you from getting stuck, and you stay in control of every click.
- [Launchpad Email Add-on](https://robcreece.com/email-addon/) ($19): Your Launchpad site gets people to sign up. This gets their emails collected and a welcome email sent from your own domain, using the Stage 6 prompt and 5 ready-to-edit welcome emails.
- [The Launchpad Bundle](https://robcreece.com/launchpad-bundle/) ($37): Everything in the Launchpad and the Email Add-on in one purchase. One chat builds your site and signup page, then the Stage 6 prompt gets your signups collected and welcomed from your own domain.
- [The Overlay Agency](https://robcreece.com/overlay-agency/) ($4): Your clients film. Software adds the on-screen graphics. You find the clients and send back the file. This short guide shows who buys, what to say and what to charge.

## Blog and videos
- [Blog](https://robcreece.com/blog/)

- [5 Ways People Can Tell AI Wrote Your Post](https://robcreece.com/blog/how-people-spot-ai-posts/): Five common giveaways that make a post read like a robot wrote it, with a quick fix for each.
- [The Small Words That Get People to Reply](https://robcreece.com/blog/words-that-get-replies/): Simple word swaps that make people more likely to reply, call or buy. No tricks, just clearer writing.
- [Do You Need a Website to Make Your First Sale?](https://robcreece.com/blog/do-you-need-a-website-to-sell/): What you actually need online to sell your first thing, and how to get it for free in an afternoon.
